title: Upgrade budget validation charges the full new-tier cost, but apply spends only the tier-delta
detail: Validate requires affording the FULL new-tier cost; apply spends only the delta. Rejects upgrades the player can actually afford, violating FR2/E1.3 'upgrade costs the tier-delta.' Workaround exists (demolish+redraw refunds full cost), so loop survives.
recommended_fix: In _validate_upgrade, check can_afford(maxi(0, new_cost - old_cost)) (the delta) instead of the full new-tier draw_cost, matching _apply_upgrade.

title: CrisisEngine S4 warning/crisis contracts (WarningSign lead times, CrisisEvent root_cause) are stubbed out
detail: S4 exit criteria unmet: no WarningSign objects with GDD lead times, no root_cause-bearing CrisisEvent, AC-E13 dedup untested. Fun-test loop still works (surge forecast surfaced, node strain via PacketFlow, win/lose via NetworkHealth) and crises are deterministic set-pieces (no fairness violation).
recommended_fix: Implement strain-driven WarningSigns + CrisisEvent with root_cause in evaluate(), or explicitly re-scope E4.1/E4.3 out of the fun-test gate with a tracked defer note.

title: Node strain/critical lead-time tunables are loaded but never applied (E3.3)
detail: E3.3 AC requires 🟡/🔴 transitions 'with the GDD lead times (strained ~30 s, critical ~10 s)'. Nodes flip the instant load crosses 70/90% — no lead/hysteresis. Surge forecast still supplies the main MVP warning.
recommended_fix: Apply strain_lead_ticks/critical_lead_ticks as a hysteresis/lead in node_health_states (sustain threshold for N ticks before transitioning).

title: Packet pool-exhaustion drop (AC-E22) not enforced — IN_FLIGHT_CAP declared but unused
evidence:
const IN_FLIGHT_CAP: int = 6000
(grep: IN_FLIGHT_CAP appears ONLY at its declaration — no reads)
_spawn_packet:
	packets.append(p)
(no capacity check before append)
detail: ADR-8 / E2.3 AC-E22 ('pool exhausted → drop lowest-priority-lane first, never silently') is not implemented; in-flight set grows unbounded. Latent for the 4–6 node MVP (unlikely to approach 6000).
recommended_fix: Cap packets.size() at IN_FLIGHT_CAP in _spawn_packet; on overflow drop the lowest-effective-lane packet first (matches E9/E22).

title: span_between uses float sqrt for a state-affecting value (ADR-10 letter deviation)
detail: ADR-10: 'All computation that affects sim state (... distance/span ...) is done in integer 'tick' or fixed-point units, not floating point.' IEEE-754 sqrt is correctly-rounded so seeded runs DO reproduce (not a determinism break) — a letter-of-ADR deviation, low risk.
recommended_fix: Use an integer-only span (integer sqrt / max(dx,dy)+min/2 fixed-point), or record a documented ADR-10 sqrt exception.
